### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

### Problem Statement / User Need
Is your feature request related to a problem or user pain point? Describe the context (e.g. "As a senior citizen, I want...").

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or design approach you would like to see implemented.

### Alternative Approaches Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, or screenshots about the feature request here.
